title: Symmetry and Approximate Symmetry for Solutions of Mixed Local-Nonlocal Singular Equations
summary: In this article, we establish radial symmetry for positive weak solutions of a class of mixed local-nonlocal equations with possibly singular nonlinearity via the moving plane method. Furthermore, we provide a quantitative version of Gidas-Ni-Nirenberg type theorem for mixed local-nonlocal equations. In this regard, we establish a weak Harnack-type inequality and an analogue of the Alexandroff-Bakelman-Pucci inequality in the mixed nonhomogeneous setting with a lower order term, which appear to be new.
